note: What there is to do at a place, derived from its tags. These are the common verbs made fast — never the limit of what can be attempted, which stays whatever the player types. Each one names a venue, because a named counter at a named place beats a Socialize button.
costNote: Cyberpunk RED prints no price for a bowl of noodles or a jug of water, so these are house-rule prices anchored to the published cost ladder the Night Market uses: Cheap 10, Everyday 20, Costly 50, Premium 100. Nothing here may sit between rungs — a test holds them to the ladder — and anything the engine already prices (a repair, a ripperdoc's bill, a night's stock) is left at null for the engine to answer.
capNote: How many things a place offers at once. Five. A location that lists everything it could conceivably support is a menu, and the player stops reading menus.
localNote: Some doors you only find if you know the area. An action flagged `local` is offered as a shortcut ONLY to somebody who knows this neighbourhood — a local (Local Expert, through placeIntel's `neighbourhood` rung) or somebody who has already been to that venue and so knows it is there. It is never removed from the world: the map still travels anywhere, a job can still send you, and the narrator can still put you in front of it. What being a stranger costs you is the shortcut, not the place.

actions.label: Get something to eat
actions.description: Whatever is hot and quick.

actions.label: Sit down and eat
actions.description: A proper meal, at a table, with time to think.

actions.label: Have a drink
actions.description: Nurse one at the bar and see who else is in.

actions.label: Stay for the music
actions.description: Pay the door and let the evening go somewhere.

actions.label: See what's for sale
actions.description: Walk the stalls without committing to anything.

actions.label: Fill your bottles
actions.description: However long the line is, you still need the water.

actions.label: Buy vegetables
actions.description: Grown here, which is rarer than it should be.

actions.label: Lend a hand
actions.description: There is always more to do here than there are people to do it.

actions.label: See about chrome
actions.description: Ask what they have in and what it would cost you.
actions.localNote: The unlicensed surgery is found by asking somebody who knows.

actions.label: Get looked at
actions.description: Somebody here can close a wound properly.

actions.label: Get something fixed
actions.description: Hand it over and find out what it will take.

actions.label: Ask around
actions.description: Enough people through here that somebody knows something.

actions.label: Look in on the neighbours
actions.description: People who live where you live, and notice when you don't.

actions.label: Have a look round
actions.description: Nobody is stopping you. That is not the same as nobody being here.
actions.localNote: Knowing which empty building is worth walking into, and which is occupied.

actions.label: Sit for a while
actions.description: Open ground, and nothing that needs you in it.

actions.label: Go up top
actions.description: Everything looks manageable from above it.

actions.label: See what's on
actions.description: Somebody is performing, or playing, or pretending to.

actions.label: Take a room
actions.description: Somewhere that is not yours, for a night that is.

actions.label: Pay respects
actions.description: Somewhere the city keeps its dead, and stays quiet about it.

actions.label: See what's moving
actions.description: Freight tells you things about a city that people will not.

actions.label: Spend the evening
actions.description: Somewhere built to take money off you pleasantly.

actions.label: Ask what came in
actions.description: Nobody here asks where anything came from, which cuts both ways.
actions.localNote: Nobody advertises where stolen goods change hands.

actions.label: Sit with the families
actions.description: Food, an argument about a route, and nobody asking what you do.

actions.label: Cash a transfer
actions.description: Somebody else’s money becomes yours, minus whatever the counter takes.

actions.label: Sign in at reception
actions.description: A badge, your name in a log, and half an hour of somebody else’s day.

actions.label: Make an appointment
actions.description: You will not be seen today. Being written down is the whole of the win.

actions.label: Ask what they are working on
actions.description: The answer is public, sanitised, and still more than you knew this morning.

actions.label: Sell what you saw
actions.description: They buy footage, rumour and eyewitness, and pay badly for all three.

actions.label: Sit in on something
actions.description: Nobody checks. An hour of somebody teaching something they actually know.

actions.label: File it and wait
actions.description: The form exists. Whether anything happens to it is a separate question.

actions.label: Report it
actions.description: They will take it down. Taking it down is not the same as doing anything.

actions.label: Watch the door
actions.description: Who goes in, who comes out, and who they nod to on the way past.
actions.localNote: Knowing which door is worth watching in the first place.

actions.label: Take the train
actions.description: Somewhere else, for the price of a ticket and the length of the ride.

actions.label: Look for a shift
actions.description: They are always short, and it always pays less than the board said.

actions.label: Take a bunk
actions.description: A mattress, a locker that does not lock, and nobody asking your name.
actions.localNote: A bed nobody writes your name down for is not on a sign.

actions.label: Talk your way past the desk
actions.description: The lobby is the whole security model, and the lobby is a person.

actions.label: See whose street this is
actions.description: Colours, tags, and who stands where. Worth knowing before you need it.
actions.localNote: Reading a claim off the walls takes knowing whose walls they are.

approachNote: An APPROACH is not business. The verbs above are things to do — buy, eat, drink, get patched up; these are ways of LOOKING, and they exist because the truth system gave the city things to find and nothing on the screen ever offered to look for them. An approach offers a way in and never a finding: it says 'slow down and examine the place', never 'there is something behind the counter'. That is what makes it safe to offer somewhere with nothing to find — 'you search and the place is what it appears to be' is a real answer the engine already gives. They are listed in PRIORITY order, not file order: the cap is small and a fixed file order left Conversation's card firing nowhere in the whole city. A conclusion goes first because it was earned; looking properly comes next because it is the verb the whole truth system hangs on.
approachSkillNote: `skill` is the printed Skill the card leans on. The engine sets no DV here: the difficulty belongs to the thing being found, which the engine knows and this card must not hint at. `needsConclusion` is the one exception to offering blind — a conclusion's prerequisites are other discoveries, so it is only offered once the character has earned the pieces, and offering it is a pay-off rather than a hint.

approaches.label: Think it through
approaches.description: Sit with what you already know about this place and see what it adds up to.

approaches.label: Look closer
approaches.description: Slow down and go over the place properly instead of passing through it.

approaches.label: Read the room
approaches.description: Watch faces instead of talking to them, and see who is not comfortable.

roleActionCapNote: How many of a place's offers may be things only this Role would think of. Two, on their own budget beside the five, for the same reason approaches are: a Role move that has to beat 'fill your bottles' for a slot is a Role move nobody ever sees. Reserved rather than unlimited, because a district that offers a Lawman nothing but police work has stopped being a city.
roleActionNote: House rule, like everything else in this file. A Role action is the ordinary business of being somewhere AS this person: it names a real venue found by the same tags, costs the minutes it prints, and grants nothing. What a Role ABILITY does, and how far a Rank reaches, stay in roles.json and roleAbility.ts — none of these cards touch either. `roles` is the Role ids that see the card; a card with a `skill` is an approach, and carries no DV for the same reason the others do not.

roleActions.label: Run it against the system
roleActions.description: Sit at a terminal you still have a login for and pull what the department holds on a name, a plate or a face.

roleActions.label: Show the badge
roleActions.description: Let the room see what you are and watch what it does about it. Some of them go quiet. Some of them leave.

roleActions.label: Work the price
roleActions.description: Take the number apart in front of whoever quoted it. The first one is never the one.

roleActions.label: Find who moves this
roleActions.description: Ask the people who would know who handles this kind of thing in this district, and what they want for an introduction.

roleActions.label: Get under the vehicle
roleActions.description: Somewhere with a lift, a light and nobody asking. Whatever you are driving comes out of it better than it went in.

roleActions.label: Ask the road
roleActions.description: Find whoever came in off the highway recently. Another family has been through this and somebody talked about it.

roleActions.label: Play it where it's heard
roleActions.description: Take the stage, the corner, the speaker — whatever this place has — and give the room something. People remember who moved them.

roleActions.label: Find who wants leading
roleActions.description: Read the room for the ones who are angry and waiting for somebody to say it out loud.

roleActions.label: Get it on record
roleActions.description: Camera up, recorder running, or a witness who will say it again with their name on it. Nothing you cannot prove is worth anything.

roleActions.label: Ask the question nobody asks
roleActions.description: Walk in as press and put the thing everyone is working around directly to somebody who has to answer it.

roleActions.label: See to people here
roleActions.description: Set up where there is nobody else doing it. You are paid in what people tell you while you work.

roleActions.label: Read what happened to them
roleActions.description: What did this, how long ago, and whether whoever it was walked away afterwards.

roleActions.label: Open it up
roleActions.description: Get the panel off whatever is broken here and find out why it actually failed, which is rarely what they told you.

roleActions.label: Buy an hour at the bench
roleActions.description: Somewhere with a vice, power and parts bins nobody counts. What you make there is yours.

roleActions.label: Find out who signs for this
roleActions.description: Somebody owns this operation and somebody approves its spending. Those are usually not the same person.

roleActions.label: Spend the company's name
roleActions.description: Use the letterhead while it still opens things. It does not open everything and it does not open it twice.

roleActions.label: Case the ground
roleActions.description: Exits, angles, who is armed and who only looks it. Do it now so you are not working it out later under fire.

roleActions.label: Find the architecture
roleActions.description: Whatever is running behind these walls has to reach the street somewhere. Find where.
